From a background in cardiac nursing to a thriving career in real estate, Cynthia has seamlessly transitioned from healing hearts of her patients to the heart of your homes, embodying the spirit of service and compassion every step of the way. Born and raised in the heart of East Tennessee, Cynthia embodies the values of hard work, integrity, and community that define the region. With roots deeply intertwined with the land and its people, Cynthia brings a unique understanding of the local market and a passion for helping clients find their place in this vibrant corner of the world. From Registered Nurse to Realtor, after years of dedicated service as a cardiac RN, Cynthia felt a calling to pursue a new path—one that would allow her to continue making a difference in people\u0027s lives while fulfilling her passion for real estate. Drawing upon her innate empathy, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence, Cynthia seamlessly transitioned into the world of real estate, where she quickly distinguished herself as a trusted advisor and advocate for her clients. At the heart of Cynthia\u0027s approach to real estate is a commitment to care, rooted in her background as a healthcare professional. Whether guiding first-time homebuyers through the complexities of the buying process, preparing to sell or invest, or assisting families in transition, Cynthia brings a unique blend of compassion, expertise, and personalized attention to every transaction, ensuring that each client feels supported and empowered every step of the way. As Cynthia looks to the future, the vision is clear: to continue serving as a beacon of excellence and integrity in the East Tennessee real estate market, helping clients achieve their dreams of homeownership and investing while upholding the values of honesty, respect, and compassion. item.description: My name is Dean Arrington, and my family and I have proudly called the Tri-Cities home for the past 14 years. My wife, Jane, and I have been married for 26 years, and family is at the center of our lives. We are blessed with a daughter, Taylor, a son, Mason, and a grandson, Gray. After raising our family here and becoming part of the community, the Tri-Cities is much more than where we live—it is home. After a rewarding career with Eastman Chemical, I retired in April 2026 and decided to pursue a career in real estate. Throughout my professional career, I learned the importance of hard work, integrity, communication, attention to detail, and following through on commitments. Those are the same qualities I bring to every real estate transaction. After buying and selling many homes of my own, I understand that buying or selling a home is a big decision. It can be exciting, but it can also feel overwhelming. My goal is to make the process as smooth, stress-free, and positive as possible while helping you make informed decisions every step of the way. Whether you are buying your first home, selling a longtime family home, relocating to the Tri-Cities, or simply looking for your next chapter, I want to be someone you can trust and depend on throughout the process.

item.name: Cynthia Conner
item.description: "Hearts to Homes" - The Journey of Cynthia Conner, an East Tennessee Realtor Welcome to the extraordinary journey of Cynthia, a Realtor born and raised amidst the rolling hills and warm hospitality of East Tennessee. From a background in cardiac nursing to a thriving career in real estate, Cynthia has seamlessly transitioned from healing hearts of her patients to the heart of your homes, embodying the spirit of service and compassion every step of the way. Born and raised in the heart of East Tennessee, Cynthia embodies the values of hard work, integrity, and community that define the region. With roots deeply intertwined with the land and its people, Cynthia brings a unique understanding of the local market and a passion for helping clients find their place in this vibrant corner of the world. From Registered Nurse to Realtor, after years of dedicated service as a cardiac RN, Cynthia felt a calling to pursue a new path—one that would allow her to continue making a difference in people's lives while fulfilling her passion for real estate. Drawing upon her innate empathy, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence, Cynthia seamlessly transitioned into the world of real estate, where she quickly distinguished herself as a trusted advisor and advocate for her clients. At the heart of Cynthia's approach to real estate is a commitment to care, rooted in her background as a healthcare professional. Whether guiding first-time homebuyers through the complexities of the buying process, preparing to sell or invest, or assisting families in transition, Cynthia brings a unique blend of compassion, expertise, and personalized attention to every transaction, ensuring that each client feels supported and empowered every step of the way. As Cynthia looks to the future, the vision is clear: to continue serving as a beacon of excellence and integrity in the East Tennessee real estate market, helping clients achieve their dreams of homeownership and investing while upholding the values of honesty, respect, and compassion. With a dedication to continuous learning, innovation, and unparalleled service, Cynthia is poised to leave a lasting legacy of excellence in real estate and a profound impact on the lives of those she serves. Join Cynthia on the journey to finding your dream home in East Tennessee, where each transaction is infused with warmth, integrity, and a genuine commitment to your happiness and success. From healing hearts to the heart of your homes, Cynthia is honored to be your trusted partner every step of the way.

item.name: Tina Gale
item.description: With a career built on integrity, leadership, and a true passion for serving others, Tina Gale is a dedicated real estate professional specializing in both buyer and seller representation across Northeast Tennessee. A Kingsport native, Tina graduated from Sullivan North High School and studied Organizational Management at Tusculum College before earning her real estate license in 2010. She now proudly serves as the Principal Broker and Co-Owner of Conservus Homes. Tina has continued to elevate her expertise through advanced education and industry recognition. Tina and her husband, Mack - also a licensed REALTOR® with Conservus Homes - share two daughters and two granddaughters, who remain her greatest joy. Outside the office, she enjoys traveling, spending time with her family, and supporting local youth sports programs. Known for her exceptional communication, availability, and client-first approach, Tina’s mission is simple: to make every real estate experience smooth, seamless, and stress-free. “I am truly passionate about helping buyers and sellers achieve their real estate goals. Let me guide you through the process and create a successful, stress-free experience for you.” – Tina
